notes.title: Living in a Brothel v0.4.1 released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/654e6bb360cb05175013025f3813304bf7e9a283.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/d72d8b30a7cb57626365d32f4d77a1b4510f21a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/9be3b472106b538f8a3907b156f2235510a2384e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/326e736d6c38d10ce550984de95e62f047fe18f3.png[/img]
What's up, guys!
We’re thrilled to announce that Living in a Brothel version 0.4.1 is officially here!
This update brings a mix of fresh content, polish, and that special flair you’ve come to love.

You may find it weird that the title says v0.4.1 and not v0.4.0, but that's exactly what it is.
During the testing phase, we discovered some bugs and took the opportunity to fix them before launching on Steam.
This version, with the bugs fixed, was called v0.4.1.

Without further ado, here’s what’s new:
[h2]============//============[/h2]
[h1]Version 0.4.1:[/h1]
[h3]Fucking Your Customer Scene Remake:[/h3]

Fixed an issue where the main character had female nails in some parts of this scene.
To do this, we needed to redo several renders and animations:
[list]
[*] 19 Renders Remade
[*] 7 Animations Remade
[/list]
[h3]Improvements:[/h3]

[b]Gamepad A Button Update:[/b] The gamepad A button now functions similarly to the left mouse button instead of the Enter button as it did previously.
This allows you to drag and collect Secret Cards from posters. (Steam Version Only)

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

Fixed a bug where clicking on some Gallery Image thumbnails in the menu would incorrectly display a different Gallery Image than the one selected.
[h2]============//============[/h2]
[h1]Version 0.4.0:[/h1]
[h3]New Content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 283 New Renders
[*] 61 New Animations
[*] 7 New Gallery Images
[*] 7 New Scenes
[*] 5 New Songs
[*] 2 New Achievements
[*] 2 Gallery Images were turned into animations
[/list]
[h3]New Features:[/h3]

[b]Exploring the City:[/b] Now the player will be able to access other parts of the city by exiting through the bar's entrance door.
For now, the only accessible location is the gym, but in the future, more locations in the city will be accessible as the story progresses.

[b]Steam Cloud Support:[/b] Added support for the Steam Cloud feature.
You can now share your save between different devices when playing the Steam version, as well as keep a backup of your save in the cloud.

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]

[b]Monochromatic Effect:[/b] The code related to the monochromatic effect, which is used in character memories, has been optimized.
It's now possible to use this effect in animations.

[b]Updated Achievements Requirements:[/b] The requirements for unlock the achievements listed in the Achievement Menu have been updated to include the new content in this version.
Players will need to complete the requirements related to the new content in order to unlock achievements that were previously present in the game.

[b]Automatic New Clothes:[/b] The code related to the implementation of renders that change the character's outfit depending on the day the game is in has been optimized.
Now, new outfits that appears in future updates will be included automatically, without the need for changes to the code.

[b]Way to unlock Gallery Images updated:[/b] 13 Gallery Images that were previously automatically unlocked in bulk are now unlocked via Secret Cards or through the main storyline, one by one.

[b]Jackpot Animation:[/b] When you hit a Jackpot in the Slot Machine Minigame, an animation is played along with the previously existing sound effect from now on.

[b]Performance Boost:[/b] We have optimized the use of cache memory and RAM, ensuring a significant performance gain. On the other hand, the game's RAM usage has increased and, consequently, the required specifications.
This has resulted in faster loading of game files, which can be especially noticeable in animations, which now run smoothly. You'll also notice that the game will respond more quickly to your inputs from now on.

[h3]Adjustments:[/h3]

[b]Committed Reader Achievement:[/b] We've reduced the percentage of script that must be read to unlock this achievement from 95% to 90%.
This achievement was harder to unlock than we planned, so we've adjusted the requirements to make it easier for players to reach.

[b]Diagonal Jackpots:[/b] From now on, when you manage to line up 3 "7s" or 3 "BARs" diagonally in the Slot Machine Minigame, it'll count as a Jackpot.
We initially decided to only count a Jackpot when you lined up 3 "7s" or 3 "BARs" in the center, as we wanted this to be a hard achievement to unlock, but we felt that the difficulty was higher than we had planned.
This change should make it easier to unlock the Jackpot achievement, while still keeping it sufficiently challenging.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

Fixed a bug where "The Curious Girl" scene was unlocked in the Replay section before being completed during gameplay.

Fixed a bug where, in specific situations, character icons would not load during mobile conversations, messing up the layout, and consequently, it was not possible to read them properly.
[h2]============//============[/h2]
A huge thank you to our amazing community for your support so far – you’re the reason we keep pushing Living in a Brothel forward. If you haven’t already, hop into our [url=https://discord.com/invite/9wnXg9vqA4]Discord server[/url] to share your thoughts, report bugs, or just chat.
Time to head back to the brothel and see what version 0.4.1 has in store for you.
Cheers! 🍻

[h2]What's new in version 0.4.0?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/e6b70ff6c30630b14c3a8d0d26f75a09d0865a30.png[/img]

In the testing phase, we take the opportunity to fix bugs we found and implement some changes that we didn't have the opportunity to implement previously, but that would have been welcome.

In short, we took the opportunity to optimize the experience as much as possible before making the new update available to the public, as we want our players' experience to be the best possible.

Let's briefly talk about everything that has been implemented so far:

[h3]Exploring the City:[/h3] From this version onwards, the player will be able to explore new locations in the city by exiting through the bar's entrance door.
At first, we only have the gym available, but in the future more locations will be accessible.

[h3]Steam Cloud Support:[/h3] We have a new feature exclusive to the Steam version, Steam Cloud support.
You can now share your save between different devices using Steam's cloud service, and you can also keep a backup of your save.

This is a feature requested by some players that, for technical reasons, had not been implemented until now, but we have overcome this limitation and made this feature available to players starting with this update.

[h3]Monochromatic Effect:[/h3] The code related to the monochromatic effect, which is used in character memories, has been optimized.
It's now possible to use this effect in animations.

[h3]Updated Achievements Requirements:[/h3] The requirements needed to earn achievements that already existed in the game have been updated to accommodate the new content available in this update.

This means that, for example, to unlock the "Detective" achievement, which consists of unlocking all Gallery Images, the player will also have to unlock the new Gallery Images that were added in this version.

[h3]Automatic New Clothes:[/h3] The code related to the implementation of renders that change the character's outfit depending on the day the game is in has been optimized.
Now, new outfits that appears in future updates will be included automatically, without the need for changes to the code.
This is a "back end" update and will not be noticed by the player during gameplay, but it'll help in the development of future versions.

[h3]Way to unlock Gallery Images updated:[/h3] One of the improvements we had previously planned to make was to distribute the Gallery Images that refer to Escort Forum (chapters related to Thomas' story) as Secret Cards throughout these same chapters, as we consider this Secret Card mechanic to be the one that players like the most.

In previous updates, we opted to, as a preliminary step, unlock all of these Gallery Images at once upon reaching the end of Thomas' story, as we did not have enough time to implement them properly in the game.

We have now implemented them as Secret Cards, according to what our team had planned.

The same was done with the 4 Gallery Images unlocked at the end of the scene The Bunny and the Kitty, which have now also been distributed as Secret Cards throughout the game.

If you want to try to find them, but have already finished the game, we recommend that you delete your save and start a new one.

[h3]Jackpot Animation:[/h3] When you hit a Jackpot in the Slot Machine Minigame, an animation is played along with the previously existing sound effect from now on.

[h3]Performance Boost:[/h3] We have optimized the use of cache memory and RAM, ensuring a significant performance gain. On the other hand, the game's RAM usage has increased and, consequently, the required specifications.

This has resulted in faster loading of game files, which can be especially noticeable in animations, which now run smoothly. You'll also notice that the game will respond more quickly to your inputs from now on.

Some users reported slow loading of animations, so we decided to work on solving the issue.
We hope that with this performance gain, animations will load immediately or, if that is not the case, at least more quickly.

Starting with this update, we recommend at least 3GB of RAM to run the PC version and 2GB of RAM to run the mobile version.

Using devices with lower specifications than this may result in the game not running properly. In practice, this may make it impossible for the game to run on really old mobile devices, but it generated a significant performance gain on the vast majority of other devices.

[h3]Committed Reader Achievement:[/h3] We've reduced the percentage of script that must be read to unlock this achievement from 95% to 90%.
This achievement was harder to unlock than we planned, so we've adjusted the requirements to make it easier for players to reach.

[h3]Diagonal Jackpots:[/h3] From now on, when you manage to line up 3 "7s" or 3 "BARs" diagonally in the Slot Machine Minigame, it'll count as a Jackpot.

We initially decided to only count a Jackpot when you lined up 3 "7s" or 3 "BARs" in the center, as we wanted this to be a hard achievement to unlock, but we felt that the difficulty was higher than we had planned.

This change should make it easier to unlock the Jackpot achievement, while still keeping it sufficiently challenging.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3] We found some bugs in the previous version, v0.3.1, and took the chance to fix them before releasing v0.4.0.

The bugs we found were minor and didn't have a major impact on gameplay, with the exception of a bug where character icons would disappear during mobile conversations in specific situations.
In these rare cases, the mobile system layout would become messed up and the message would become impossible to read. This problem is now solved.
We also took the opportunity to fix even minor bugs.

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
And finally we have reached the end!
We talked a lot in this news, as there was a lot of stuff to tell you, but as we were focused on development, we ended up leaving it a little aside.

We hope you enjoy the new content and the improvements can make your gameplay even better.
Cheers! 🍻

[h2]Julia Pole Dance Scene - Animation[/h2]
[previewyoutube=O_zuGhCF_Ug;full][/previewyoutube]
This news highlight surely is the preview video attached to this topic, which shows the final result of this animation.

This is the most complex animation we've worked on so far, with 588 different frames in a single animation. It's a lot of work, but we decided to go all out on this animation because it's the main theme of this episode, so we want it to be really well done.
We had to pose frame by frame, adjusting every detail of the character's body, such as posing each limb, each finger, etc. In addition, we had to make the pose so that there is continuity compared to the previous frames, so that the animation is fluid.
It's quite an achievement, so we hope you enjoy the final result, which you can see in the preview video attached to this topic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/cfb38bd2474e7889a9e6821629c512ba59552848.png[/img]
This animation will also have a nude variant that will be part of the same scene. Initially, she was going to dance just wearing the bikini, but we thought players would want to see Julia dancing completely naked, so we decided to include this second version as an extension of the scene.
The nude variant has also had its posing process completed.
This animation is currently in the rendering process.
It'll be posted here at the next opportunity, as it should be finished by then.

We created a script for what will happen during this scene:
[olist]
[*] She'll walk down the catwalk wearing the bikini.
[*] She'll do the Pole Dance wearing the bikini.
[*] There'll be a pause and she'll take off her clothes, throwing it into the audience. (It'll just disappear completely)
[*] She'll do the Pole Dance again, but this time without clothes.
[*] She'll walk out to the dressing room, completely nude.
[/olist]
We decided to start with the Pole Dance animation itself, as it's the hardest.
Now that it's done, step 4 of the script will automatically be done as well, since it's the same animation, being just a variation.

Some extra facts about this scene: Unlike the looping animations we usually do, this is an animation that goes from beginning to end once and then ends, which is what makes it so laborious, as it takes more unique frames for the animation to be better utilized.
On the other hand, the final result of the animation is superior, as it presents new movements from beginning to end and, in our opinion, this increases the quality of the animation, as there's always the novelty factor when watching it for the first time.
We also decided to include the backwards version in it, as we realized that this creates an interesting result, so we can increase the duration of the animation and make it loopable, even though we only plan to play it once.

The Julia Pole Dance Scene is not complete yet, as we still have the animations of Julia entering and exiting the catwalk to do, but these animations are extremely easier to do than the pole dance one, so it won't be long until they are done and we can consider this scene finished.
We'll probably bring the conclusion of this scene, along with the missing animations, in the next post.

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
We know you like to have regular news on the project's development, but there is a reason why we decided to postpone publishing news.
As you can see, most of the progress we've made is related to dialogue between characters or progress in gameplay-related parts.
Although they're also important parts of the game and add to the final product, they don't have the same appeal to the audience as the sex scenes.
For this reason, we decided to wait to accumulate more content and complete at least one erotic scene before posting news here, as we understand that news that only contained dialogue between characters would not be fun.

We apologize for the inconvenience to those eagerly awaiting the next update, and we understand your desire to play and see the content that will arrive in the next version.
We appreciate your interest in following our work and eagerly awaiting each update, because without it, we would have no reason to continue working on the development of this project.
Despite the setbacks, we assure you that we're continuing to actively work on this project and we're really excited to release the next update.

We've never been closer to the release of episode 4, with just one sex scene left to do after we finish the current one, so it's time to get hyped!
We hope you're enjoying what you're seeing in the previews so far.
Cheers! 🍻

Hello everyone!
It has been some time since the release of v0.3.1 and, although there has been enough time for the release of v0.4, it has not yet occurred.
There's a reason for this: There was an unforeseen event during development that caused us to delay our development schedule. However, we make it clear to everyone: [b]Development of this game continues active and a new version will be released as soon as possible.[/b]

Let's start by explaining some questions our players may have.

[h2]If development continues to be active, why hasn't any news about the game been published here in the meantime?[/h2]
Until now, we had reserved progress reports showing the work being done only for another platform that we have designed to show this type of content. Initially, we had only reserved patch notes for updates actually released for Steam, but we realized that some players only find out about the progress of development work on Early Access games here, unaware of the existence of other platforms, so we decided to bring these progress reports to Steam as well to keep everyone informed.

We had not noticed this behavior before on the part of players, having even given us some negative feedback, so we apologize for our mistake.

[h2]What was the reason for the delay in the v0.4 release?[/h2]
In the first moments right after the release of v0.3.1, we had planned to do voice acting for all the game's dialogue, using AI.

What's up, guys!
This time, we're here to bring you great news: a new update for Living in a Brothel has been released, version 0.3.1.

Let's talk briefly about each point of this new update:

[b]============//============[/b]
[b]The Bunny and the Kitty (New Scene):[/b] This is the scene that had been planned for v0.3.0, but ended up being postponed due to lack of time.

This is the unlockable sex scene if the player delivers the Kitty Cosplay to Veronika on day 2. To access it, when you finish talking to Beatrice and she asks you to go and call the girls for the photo shoot at on the 4th day, you'll have to go to Veronika's room.
Doing this will automatically start the scene.

This is the biggest sex scene ever created so far: It's almost completely animated, has several different positions involving the 3 characters (MC, Luna and Veronika) and several different camera angles as well.

Furthermore, it has different possible endings, which are the ways in which the MC can cum in the scene, varying according to the choices the player makes.

Therefore, it's recommended to use the Replay feature to see all possible endings of this scene.

There are also some interesting extra renders, such as posters of Luna and Veronika taking a shower, which can be accessed by going to their bathroom, after the aforementioned scene, as well as some interesting Gallery Images, such as some animations that came from the Dynamic Duo scene, but with the girls wearing their respective cosplays.

Now we can say that we have finally completed the development of v0.3, including all the content that had been planned for it.

[b]============//============[/b]
[b]Hide the Dialog Box:[/b] As stated above, we took the opportunity to bring some interesting features that ended up being excluded from the game for one reason or another. One of these features is the possibility of hiding the dialog box to better appreciate the render or animation that is being displayed on the screen.

This feature had been removed from the game in the first versions, due to incompatibility with the game's Free Roaming system.

What happened is that, when using the H key to hide the dialogue, it ended up hiding things that it shouldn't, such as the clickable buttons in the scenarios and the Secret Cards.

However, due to it being a feature loved by players of Visual Novels made with Ren'py, some players complained about the feature's removal.

Because of this, we decided to look into the problem and came up with a solution that makes it possible to hide just the dialog and not the entire interface as happens by default in Ren'py.

Therefore, the clickable buttons are no longer hidden when pressing the H key and, with that, it was possible to bring this feature back.

[b]============//============[/b]
[b]Gamepad Support:[/b] It's now possible to play Living in a Brother using a gamepad.
Yes, this was another default Ren'py feature that had been removed by us due to incompatibilities with some game features.

The biggest problem was, once again, related to the Free Roaming mode. What happens is that this game mode is completely dependent on the mouse to work and, therefore, we needed a way to move the cursor around the screen so that the gamepad could be correctly implemented.

Unfortunately, the ability to control the mouse cursor with the gamepad is not a feature offered natively by Ren'py, which made us disable the feature completely, as we would rather not have the feature than release it with bugs.

However, we realized that, when using the Steam API, it's possible to control the mouse cursor with the analog sticks, which was a game changer for our goal of implementing gamepad support.

In this regard, we have created an official default configuration in Steam Controller Settings, so that players can use it here. It's the "Official Layout for Living In A Brothel - Gamepad Configuration".

All references to the ingame gamepad were based on this configuration, so it is highly recommended that you use it if you are going to play with the gamepad.

Despite this, if you prefer, you can remap the buttons to your liking, but the ingame references will not change to follow this change, ok?

Finally, for those who like to play from the comfort of their sofa, it's now possible to use a good gamepad for that.

[b]============//============[/b]
[b]Steam Deck Support:[/b] One of the reasons that led us to work on Gamepad Support was the need to adapt our game to the Steam Deck, as there were some technical obstacles passed on to us by Valve that prevented the game from working correctly on the Steam Deck.

Therefore, we decided to strive to adapt it to Valve's requirements, so that the game could be enjoyed on that platform as well.

The first step was to configure the game to work well with the gamepad buttons, which will make it also work well with the Steam Deck physical buttons, as this is interpreted as a gamepad too. We also made some adaptations to the button commands explained in the tutorials to show the gamepad/Steam Deck buttons, if the player has a controller connected or is playing on the Deck.

Finally, we fixed an issue involving the Steam Deck virtual keyboard not working properly.

The new version is ready for you to play on your Steam Deck without any problems.

[b]============//============[/b]
[b]Walkthrough Button:[/b] A new button has been added to the Title Screen, if the game detects that you have the Living in a Brothel - Official Guide (DLC) pdf in the game/walkthrough folder.

This is nothing more than a hyperlink that searches for the guide files in the specified folder and, if found, the button is displayed on the Title Screen.

When you download the walkthrough, it'll be placed in the correct folder automatically, which will make this button appear, allowing you to access the walkthrough from within the game itself.

The walkthrough button will open the English or Portuguese version, depending on the language selected in the Options menu.

[b]============//============[/b]
[b]Help Screen Update & Gamepad Glyphs Support:[/b] This has already been explained above, so we won't dwell on it here.
Briefly, screens such as the Help Screen, Tooltip Screen (Shown during elevator rides) and the Tutorials have been updated so that if a gamepad is connected (this includes the Steam Deck), the game will reference the gamepad buttons instead of mouse and keyboard buttons.

[b]============//============[/b]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b] We found some bugs in the previous version, v0.3.0, and took the chance to fix them before releasing v0.3.1.

Most of the bugs are small and don't have much impact on gameplay, with the exception of one, which was quite important, but we hadn't noticed before.

If you want to know more about the fixed bugs, take a look at the patch notes. (Shown in screenshots.)

[b]============//============[/b]
